notes.title: 🎮 Hidden Kitten: Day One Patch (v1.0.0.5) is Live! 🐱‍🚀
notes.content:
Hello gamers! 😎

The day one patch for Hidden Kitten (version 1.0.0.5) just went live!
🛠 Fixes

  Achievement 'Cat-astrophe': Was not unlockable if a level was restarted after finding the 'Planet' .
  Object Colorization: Objects covered by balloons would not be colorized if the balloon covering them was clicked on initially and the object was found later.
  Achievement 'That's Insane!': Was not unlockable if the level was restarted after finding the 'Balloon Dog', 'Willy' or the 'Heart' in 'Furry Fiesta Funpark' on the first try.
  'Key' in 'Ad Astra': Was not interactible after it appeared on the ground.

Thanks to everyone who has been playing and especially to those who provided feedback! 🐈
Greetings from the Devs! 🤓
